default_summary: Autonomous AI Agentic Developer, Full-Stack Software Engineer, and QA Software Tester with deep expertise in building, testing, and deploying production-grade web applications, SaaS platforms, and native desktop systems. Specializes in Python, FastAPI, React, Next.js, Electron, and LLM Agent orchestration (tool-calling, AST reasoning, and multi-agent workflows). Experienced in end-to-end quality assurance (QA), manual and automated testing, exploratory testing, bug reporting, and performance audits across web, SaaS, and desktop applications. Architected Pasha Hunt 2.0 (an autonomous AI career agent desktop platform) and SARA AI 2.5 Pro.

projects.name: Pasha Hunt 2.0: Autonomous AI Career Agent & Job Hunter Desktop Platform
projects.tech: Python, Tkinter, PyInstaller, Headless Edge, IMAP/SMTP, Gemini/Apinex LLMs, Multi-threading
projects.text: Architected and built an autonomous career agent desktop platform that aggregates live tech opportunities from 16+ global and Pakistani channels. Features anti-hallucination fact-grounded ATS resume & cover letter generation into tailored PDFs, automated multi-draft Gmail IMAP workflows, real-time recruiter response tracking, and 1-click AI interview battle-pack generation. Conducted rigorous end-to-end QA, UI/UX polish with Windows 11 immersive dark mode, and packaged a native Windows installer.
bullets: Architected an autonomous desktop career agent aggregating tech opportunities from 16+ global platforms, Pakistani software houses, and Facebook developer communities.
Engineered an anti-hallucination ATS resume & cover letter generation pipeline that compiles tailored PDFs grounded 100% in verified candidate profile facts.
Integrated automated multi-draft Gmail IMAP workflows, real-time recruiter response tracking, and 1-click interview preparation battle-packs.
Conducted end-to-end QA testing, performance profiling, Windows 11 dark mode UX design, and built automated PyInstaller & Inno Setup deployment pipelines.

projects.name: SARA AI 2.5 Pro: Desktop AI Companion
projects.tech: Electron, React, Three.js, Node.js, Python, SQLite (FTS5)

Implemented browser automation (browser-use wrapper) and Discord webhook tooling. Voice streaming, barge-in, and vision assistance are in progress.
bullets: Engineered an Electron desktop application featuring a Node.js backend, interactive Three.js 3D avatar, and Python automation engines.
Implemented persistent memory architecture in SQLite with FTS5 full-text search for conversation recall, facts, and backups.
Engineered multi-model LLM provider adapters with automated fallback routing, screen capture, and browser automation workflows.

Engineered secure JWT authentication, real-time messaging, and high-performance RESTful APIs connecting React frontend with FastAPI backend.

Implemented high-throughput document processing engines, REST APIs, and SEO-optimized dynamic routing.

Implemented low-latency speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipelines using Faster-Whisper, Edge-TTS, and wake-word detection.
